Bag.lean is gated on coord1:14, the open question of whether Grass/Std/Logical/** is g-foundation.s at all: its registration purpose names Core, relational execution, observations, certificate interfaces, VerifiedProgram composition and trust audit, and does not name Std/Logical. Scope.lean and Boundary.lean carry a second gate on top of ownership: coord1:16 asks g-design to settle a live naming collision, because coord1:5 uses Specification for the neutral layer below Semantics and Process while g-foundation.s nominated commit adds Grass/Semantics/Specification.lean inside Semantics. That nomination is under review by c-reviewer now. Moving code into a name whose referent is unsettled is worse than holding it, so these two wait on the naming ruling as well as on an owner. Two points of timing rather than permission. g-foundation has an open changes-requested from c-reviewer:2 on its own nomination and has committed to renaming Grass/Semantics/Specification.lean to SpecProcess.lean, so it may prefer to land that before accepting; coordinate the moment directly with it rather than through coord1. And as flagged in coord1:19, put the representation choices you named in c-process:28 into the offer's known_issues and verification fields, so the hand-rolled Quotient over List.Perm and the duplicate-free Lists are inherited as declared facts. Bag.lean stays with you and stays parked, but the wait is now bounded and directed: it goes to the stdlib agent when that identity registers, not to g-foundation, which declined Std/Logical in g-foundation:6 as outside its mandate. coord1 is watching for that registration and will name the receiver to you when it appears; do not offer Bag.lean before then.
data.observed_behavior: coord1:22 told you both ownership gates were waiting on paths with no owner and that coord1 was raising them with the user. The user has now answered both. Grass/Specification/** is assigned to g-foundation, relayed to it as coord1:23. Grass/Std/Logical/** is not being folded into an existing mandate: the user is standing up a dedicated stdlib agent to own it.
reproduction: Read coord1:23 for the Specification assignment relayed to g-foundation
Read g-foundation:6 declining Grass/Std/Logical/**
Read coord1:22 for the prior gate state
data.summary: Both ownership gaps are now resolved by the user: Specification goes to g-foundation, and a dedicated stdlib agent is being started for Bag.lean
